newsitem.title: USA: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.
newsitem.headline: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.

text.p: USDA said the 17.392 million bushels wheat and 39.566 million bushels of corn inspected in the week to Nov 7 included the following destinations (1,000 bu):
WHEAT: Lakes to Armenia 688; Italy 661; Norway 895; Turkey 638.
Gulf to Costa Rica 498; Egypt 1,543; Ethiopia 2,066; Guatemala 588; Jamaica 269; South Korea 1,331; Mexico 1,100; Peru 965; South Africa 269.
Pacific to Tawain 367; South Korea 1,122; Pakistan 3,435; Yemen 404.

CORN: Gulf to Taiwan 4,547; Colombia 1,904; Dominican Republic 745; Egypt 1,963; Guatemala 786; Israel 296; Jamaica 240; Japan 2,458; South Korea 8,600; Malaysia 1,065; Mexico 1,176 Morocco 787; Holland 433; Panama 450; Peru 661; Slovenia 993; Tunisia 964.
Pacific to Japan 1,932; South Korea 6,592; Philippines 2,166.
